implementation: Strong ISO C memset/memmove in every STM32 resident and matching private SDK helpers. Exact bounded 32-bit ordinary-memory operations; memmove preserves direction within word blocks. Byte fill below 4, fixed bounded words for 4..15, bulk loops from 16. Tiny move below 16; zero/self exits. No speculative string reads.
scope: One unchanged shared-runtime APP measures actual Flash symbols through public runtime slots. Three runs per image, seven DWT samples per row; median across per-run medians. Same source/features for the pair except the added system_memory_fill_move.c. Primitive performance, not a whole-program speedup.
compiler: xPack ARM GCC 14.2.1, resident -Os without LTO
